instruction:
Implement project_coverage(receipt: dict) -> dict in telemetry_coverage.py.

The input is one Model Spelunker schema-v2 run receipt. Do not perform I/O, environment probing, provider calls, or mutation of the input.

Return exactly:
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "source": {
    "run_id": <receipt run_id>,
    "task_id": <receipt task.id>,
    "actor_configuration_digest": <receipt candidate.configuration_digest>,
    "model_provider": <receipt candidate.model.provider>,
    "model_id": <receipt candidate.model.id>,
    "runtime_placement": <receipt candidate.deployment_topology.runtime_placement>,
    "transport": <receipt candidate.deployment_topology.transport>,
    "compute_class": <receipt candidate.deployment_topology.compute_class>
  },
  "signals": [ ... ]
}

Emit exactly these signal rows, sorted lexicographically by signal:
cache_read_tokens
cache_write_tokens
human_interventions
input_tokens
logical_cpus_visible
memory_total_bytes
model_calls_completed
model_calls_started
output_tokens
platform_machine
platform_system
terminal_state
tool_calls
validator_success
wall_seconds

Every signal row must contain exactly:
signal, purpose, availability, evidence_class, value, unit, source

Use these purposes:
- terminal_state, validator_success, wall_seconds, tool_calls, human_interventions,
  logical_cpus_visible, memory_total_bytes, platform_system, platform_machine: "both"
- model_calls_started, model_calls_completed, input_tokens, output_tokens,
  cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens: "experimental"

Use evidence_class "observed" when the source field is mechanically present and non-null,
otherwise "unknown". availability must then be "available" or "unknown" respectively.
A present value of 0 or false is available/observed. Missing or null is unknown and value
must remain null. Do not coerce missing values to zero.

Use these source paths:
- observation.termination_class
- observation.success
- observation.wall_seconds
- observation.tool_calls
- observation.human_interventions
- observation.workload.model_calls_started
- observation.workload.model_calls_completed
- observation.input_tokens
- observation.output_tokens
- observation.cache_read_tokens
- observation.cache_write_tokens
- resources.logical_cpus_visible
- resources.memory_total_bytes
- resources.platform_system
- resources.platform_machine

Units:
- wall_seconds: "seconds"
- *_tokens: "provider-tokens"
- model_calls_*, tool_calls, human_interventions, logical_cpus_visible: "count"
- memory_total_bytes: "bytes"
- terminal_state, validator_success, platform_system, platform_machine: null

Do not add a score, normalized token/work unit, inferred GPU/VRAM/provider hardware,
or any signal not listed above.
